summary: Practise arbitration case preparation, hearing management and award analysis. Explore the five-day course and plan your next step.
lede: Arbitration practice for workplace and commercial disputes helps counsel, arbitrators, labour-relations specialists and case managers prepare claims, organise evidence and manage hearings. The course covers jurisdiction and arbitrability, procedural timetables, exhibit registers, witness and expert examinations, hearing logistics and award analysis, using the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules and ICC Arbitration Rules (2026) as reference frameworks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, administer or decide labour and commercial arbitration matters, from initial case review through hearings and award preparation.
modules: Digital Case Tracking and Hearing Logistics
prerequisites: Working familiarity with employment relations, commercial contracts or dispute-resolution processes is recommended. No coding is required.
